title: Wetting of brick.
officialText:
Brick (clay or shale) at the time of laying shall require wetting if the unit’s initial rate of water
absorption exceeds 21.42 grams per 30 square inches (19 355 mm2) per minute or 0.025 ounce psi (1 g/645 mm2), as determined
by ASTM C 67.
